jobs.title: PHP Developer
jobs.summary: Supported and extended a business ERP while working alongside senior developers, business analysts and end users.
achievements: Developed Tiramisu ERP features with PHP, PostgreSQL and JavaScript from business analyst requirements and refined them through senior code review.
Worked on VAT and tax reporting and the SEF project integrating the ERP with Serbia's national e-invoicing system.
Improved an ERP-connected webshop's performance and accessibility with asset-loading changes, WebP images and ARIA attributes.
Handled ERP support requests, explained product behaviour and resolved issues encountered in daily work.
Debugged PHP with Xdebug, troubleshot Apache on Ubuntu, wrote SQL joins and aggregations, and applied validation, XSS and CSRF protections.

jobs.title: Administrative Officer, Finance
jobs.summary: Maintained financial records and supported cross-language business communication before moving into software development.
achievements: Maintained payment, invoice and receivables records in Excel and Word.
Provided Turkish translation as part of the finance team's day-to-day work.
